description: A-share market-wide DAILY OVERVIEW by date, per exchange and combined: number of listed stocks, trading amount, total market cap, float (tradable) market cap and turnover rate (换手率), for the Shanghai (SSE) and Shenzhen (SZSE) exchanges, all in 100 million CNY (亿元). Answers "A-share daily turnover rate for 60 trading days", "全市场换手率", "沪深流通市值", "A-share total and float market cap on 2026-11-12", "margin balance as a share of float market cap" (divide ashares_margin_financing by float_market_cap_100m_cny), "两市成交额". Pass `date`, or `start_date` + `end_date` (or `days`, default 1 = latest trading day) for a history of one row per trading day, newest first. The SSE turnover rate is the exchange's published float-based figure; the SZSE rate and the combined rate are COMPUTED as trading amount / float market cap and labelled so. Covers stocks only (not funds or bonds). If either exchange cannot be read for a day, that day carries the error and no combined figure rather than presenting half the market as the market. Non-trading days are skipped. Source: Shanghai Stock Exchange and Shenzhen Stock Exchange, daily market overview.

date.description: One trading day, YYYY-MM-DD or YYYYMMDD. A non-trading day returns found:false with the nearest prior trading day.

days.description: Most recent N trading days, 1-90 (default 1). Each day is two exchange calls, so large N is slow; missing days are listed, never silently dropped.

start_date.description: Range start (YYYY-MM-DD). Use with end_date (default: latest).

name: ashares_market_overview

days.description: One row per trading day, newest first

combined.description: null when an exchange was unreadable

days_with_unreadable_exchange.description: Days where an exchange could not be read

title: Ashares Market Overview
